title: Automated uv.lock PRs: add team-review label after creation, not at creation
answers: Why does the uv.lock update PR get the team-review label only after a delay?
Automated uv lock PR triggers duplicate Protect runs or cancelled jobs
Where is the team-review label added for the uv lock bot PR?
Can I pass --label team-review to gh pr create in the uv workflow?
body:
Invariant: the automated uv.lock PR is created without `team-review`, then labeled in a separate step after `sleep 5`.
Enforced in .github/workflows/uv.yml (the create-or-update shell block): `gh pr create` without `--label`, then `sleep 5`, then `gh pr edit "$PR_URL" --add-label team-review`.
Why: creating and labeling back-to-back made Protect (.github/workflows/protect.yml, unchanged) start duplicate runs that cancelled each other. Separating the events reduces that race.
The delay is a mitigation, not a guarantee; scheduling delays can still cause cancellation.
Keep `gh pr merge "$PR_URL" --auto --squash` after the labeling step so auto-merge is still enabled.
Do not move the label back into `gh pr create --label` or drop the sleep without re-checking the duplicate-run incident.
applies: Only the uv.lock update automation in .github/workflows/uv.yml; existing-PR updates and protect.yml are not covered by this rule.
says: Automated dependency update pull requests trigger duplicate test pipelines that cancel each other.
Prevent conflicting checks when team review tags are added to dependency update requests.
Dependency lock pull requests fail auto-merge because validation workflows keep getting cancelled.
Automated pull requests should delay requesting team review until initial checks launch cleanly.

The auto-squash merge command gh pr merge --auto --squash must remain after the labeling step to ensure auto-merge stays active. Applies only to uv.lock update automation in .github/workflows/uv.yml, while existing PR updates and protect.yml are not covered.
